newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Third Dutch sugar beet yield at 9.0 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Third Dutch sugar beet yield at 9.0 tonnes.

text.p: The third Dutch beet forecast for 1996 showed a yield of 9.0 tonnes per hectare white value, up from 8.9 tonnes in 1995, the Institute for Sugar Research (IRS) said on Tuesday.
IRS also said the beet weight per hectare was forecast to be 56.0 tonnes per hectare against 56.0 in 1995 and compared with an annual average of 59.2 for the period 1986-95.

This is the third of the new computer-generated forecasts from the institute which replace conventional estimates based on crop reports from the field. This is the last forecast of this season, IRS added. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
